checks.label: Memory database
checks.detail: Reachable at postgresql://xana@db:5432/memory; schema up to date (7 migrations)
checks.hint: Check POSTGRES_MEMORY_URL, and that the database is running. Runs can't be stored without it.

checks.label: Time-series store
checks.detail: Reachable at postgresql://xana@db:5432/tsdb; table attributes present
checks.hint: Check TIMESCALE_DB_URL and TIMESCALE_TABLE. The agent reads signal history from it.

checks.label: Context broker
checks.hint: Check NGSI_URL. A refusal means the signed-in operator's token isn't accepted.

checks.label: Language model
checks.hint: Check LLM_PROVIDER and LLM_MODEL, and that the model has been downloaded or the key is valid.

checks.label: Dataspace gateway
checks.hint: Check GATEWAY_URL, and that the dataspace's gateway is running.

checks.label: Alert manager
checks.hint: Check ALERTA_URL, which ends in /api, and ALERTA_API_KEY. The Alerts screen and alert events use it.

checks.label: Message broker
checks.hint: Check MQTT_BROKER_URL, and that operators have Factory-Admin or Factory-Reader on client scorpio.

checks.label: History service
checks.detail: Reachable at http://pgrest:3000; table attributes can be read
checks.hint: Check PGREST_URL, and that the operator's token carries the role claim. The explorer's history uses it.

checks.label: Ontology
checks.hint: Check FUSEKI_URL and FUSEKI_DATASET, and that shapes and knowledge are loaded. Value hints use it.

checks.label: Dataspace connector
checks.hint: Connect on the Dataspace screen, and check this participant's adapter.

checks.label: IFRIC registry
checks.hint: Check IFRIC_URL, with its port, and that it shares a realm with the dataspace.

checks.label: Machine events
checks.hint: Check CALLBACK_BASE_URL, and that the context broker can reach it and an identity is available.
